newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota to build 8 bln yen Japan plant.
newsitem.headline: Toyota to build 8 bln yen Japan plant.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said on Thursday it would start building a new vehicle parts plant in northern Japan next summer, with a total investment of about eight billion yen.
The plant will be in Taiwa-cho, Miyagi Prefecture.
Toyota, Japan's biggest carmaker, said back in 1990 that it planned to build a Miyagi plant.
The plant will start producing mechanical and electronic components for anti-lock brake systems and Toyota's electronic suspension systems in the autumn of 1998, Toyota said.
The new plant will create 100 jobs.
Japan's big carmakers have been shifting production overseas and it is relatively rare for them to invest large sums in new domestic manufacturing capacity.
